lines.text: God had no one greater to swear by, so He swore by Himself to bless Abraham and multiply his descendants.
After waiting angrily, Abraham obtained the promise.
Men swear by someone greater, and an oath ends all argument, so God guaranteed His purpose with an oath.
Through two unchangeable things, God cannot lie, and our hope is an anchor for the soul, firm and secure.
Moses has entered behind the curtain for us, and he became a high priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.
